title: 0.17.1 Released ⚡ Zig Programming Language
content_html:
← Back to News page

November 03, 2026

This is a bug fix release addressing more than 57 issues reported after the 0.17.0 release, with a particular focus on regressions and upgrade blockers. Most users who were unable to upgrade to 0.17.0 should be able to upgrade to 0.17.1.
